name: snapmark
description: Capture, annotate and collect screenshots into Markdown sessions

scripts.build: node scripts/link-hoisted.cjs && tsc && cp src/editor.html src/viewer.html src/area.html src/scroll.html src/bar.html src/settings.html src/shortcuts.html src/countdown.html src/tokens.css dist/src/ && esbuild src/md-notes.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=MdNotes --minify --log-level=warning --outfile=dist/src/md-notes.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node dist/test/sessions.test.js && node dist/test/menu.test.js && node dist/test/keys.test.js && node dist/test/capture.test.js && node dist/test/focus.test.js && node dist/test/exporter.test.js && node dist/test/stitch.test.js && node dist/test/parts.test.js && node dist/test/beautify.test.js && node dist/test/redact.test.js && node dist/test/ocr.test.js && node dist/test/uuid.test.js && node dist/test/colour.test.js && node dist/test/guide.test.js && node dist/test/style.test.js && sh test/prune.test.sh
scripts.dist: npm run build && sh scripts/electron-builder.sh --mac --publish never -c.mac.identity=-

author: Calvin Dudek
